exit 0
--- stdout
Launch an interactive TUI dashboard that monitors the Liza blackboard.
The TUI provides:
- Live dashboard with color-coded status indicators for agents and tasks
- Keyboard commands to operate the system (spawn, pause, resume, add task, checkpoint, stop)
- Inline anomaly monitoring with alerts in the activity feed
- Reactive updates via fsnotify with 10s poll fallback
Use --headless for non-interactive monitoring (alerts to stderr + alerts.log).
This is suitable for CI, cron, or running in a secondary terminal.
Press '?' in the TUI for a full keybinding reference.
Usage:
liza tui [flags]
Aliases:
tui, watch
Flags:
--headless run in headless mode (no TUI, alerts to stderr + alerts.log)
-h, --help help for tui
--interval int check interval in seconds (default 10)
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
